title: Last Stone Weight
prompt: You are given an array of integers stones where stones[i] is the weight of the ith stone. We are playing a game with the stones. On each turn, we choose the heaviest two stones and smash them together. Suppose the heaviest two stones have weights x and y with x <= y. The result of this smash is: if x == y, both stones are destroyed; if x != y, the stone of weight x is destroyed, and the stone of weight y has new weight y - x. At the end of the game, there is at most one stone left. Return the weight of the last remaining stone. If there are no stones left, return 0.
hints: Use a max-heap. Repeatedly extract two largest, smash them, if difference > 0 push back the difference.
In JS: use negative values in a min-heap to simulate max-heap. Or sort and simulate.
While heap has more than 1 element: pop two, push abs(a-b) if non-zero.
